Indian residential real estate shifts toward peripheral corridors
stories.summary: India's residential real estate sector is entering a transformative phase driven by rapid urbanisation and evolving homebuyer aspirations. Development is increasingly moving toward emerging corridors and peripheral locations as cities expand beyond traditional boundaries. Improved road connectivity and metro expansions are cited as key factors in this shift.

stories.title: BPTP Limited attempts to move beyond transactional real estate
stories.summary: BPTP Limited is rethinking its customer relationship model, which historically treated homebuying as a one-time event from inquiry to handover. The developer, which manages over 25,000 active customers, aims to shift its approach to better reflect the long-term emotional and financial commitment of its buyers.

stories.title: Study suggests India needs its own home price index
stories.summary: A study by Square Yards and IIM Bangalore suggests that methods used in mature markets struggle with India's specific data constraints. Researchers reviewed six approaches for building a house-price index and identified spatiotemporal modeling as the strongest option for the local market.

stories.title: Indian entrepreneurs expand real estate footprint into UAE
stories.summary: The India-UAE business corridor is seeing increased activity as Indian entrepreneurs target the UAE for real estate expansion. Growth is driven by a business-friendly regulatory environment and rising demand for residential and commercial properties. The trend highlights the enduring relationship between the two nations.

stories.title: Emporio Malls diversifies into commercial real estate
stories.summary: Emporio Malls is expanding its national footprint beyond traditional shopping mall leasing. The brand is diversifying into commercial real estate development, property management, and financial services. It aims to cater to the evolving requirements of businesses, commercial property stakeholders, and investors across multiple geographical markets.

stories.title: Emporio Malls broadens scope across commercial infrastructure
stories.summary: Emporio Malls is establishing a brand identity across India's commercial ecosystem. The company is moving into property management, retail infrastructure, and financial services to complement its existing mall leasing business. The brand aims to explore opportunities across multiple geographical markets to serve a diverse range of stakeholders.

Yes Bank avoids default notice despite missed bond payment
stories.summary: Axis Trustee Services has not issued a default notice to Yes Bank for a missed October interest payment on 5,450 crore of AT-1 bonds. Trustees cited the difficulty of taking action while the bonds remain written off. A Reserve Bank of India review petition has further complicated the matter.

stories.title: Nigeria launches 1 trillion naira housing finance initiative
stories.summary: President Bola Tinubu has unveiled a housing scheme offering mortgages of up to 100 million naira at a 9.75 percent interest rate. The initiative, which allows for a 20-year repayment period, aims to address long-term difficulties Nigerians face in securing affordable accommodation and accessing long-term financing.

stories.summary: President Bola Tinubu has announced that eligible Nigerians can access mortgages of up to ₦100m at a fixed interest rate of 9.75 per cent, with a repayment period of up to 20 years, under the Federal Government’s housing finance initiative. The President said the facility, provided through the ₦1tn MOFI

stories.title: Nigeria reports 160 billion naira in mortgage disbursements
stories.summary: President Bola Tinubu announced that 2,300 Nigerians across 27 states have accessed 160 billion naira in mortgage loans through the MOFI Real Estate Investment Fund. The government initiative offers 100 million naira loans at 9.75 percent interest over 20 years. The president insists no political connections are required.

stories.summary: Nigerians seeking to own homes can apply for mortgage loans of up to ₦100 million under the Federal Government’s housing finance programme, which offers a fixed interest rate of 9.75 per cent and repayment periods of up to 20 years. The initiative, operated through the MOFI Real Estate Investment Fund

stories.title: India office furniture market projected to reach $8 billion by 2031
stories.summary: The Indian office furniture market is expected to reach $8 billion by 2031, driven by a shift toward integrated workplace solutions. Office absorption across India's top nine cities reached 66.4 million square feet through September 2026, an 8% increase year-on-year. Furniture is following the floor space.

stories.title: India retail leasing reaches 9.36 million square feet in 2026
stories.summary: India's retail leasing market reached 9.36 million square feet between January and September 2026, according to JLL. New mall completions in Delhi NCR and Mumbai supported the expansion. The sector is described as showing remarkable resilience, which apparently requires a steady supply of new shopping malls.

stories.title: Knight Frank sees Rs 3.76 trillion value in office retrofitting
stories.summary: A Knight Frank India study suggests 301 million square feet of office space across eight cities could be retrofitted. The firm claims this would increase asset valuations by 76%, from Rs 4.96 trillion to Rs 8.72 trillion. The report positions retrofitting as a primary driver of future growth.

stories.title: Retrofitting ageing offices could unlock Rs 3.76 trillion
stories.summary: Knight Frank India estimates that 301 million square feet of office space across eight major cities is eligible for retrofitting. The firm says this could unlock Rs 3.76 trillion in value, raising valuations by 76%. The report is titled Age to Advantage, suggesting old buildings are merely unfinished assets.

stories.title: Kolkata office retrofitting could add Rs 4,800 crore in value
stories.summary: Knight Frank India reports that 25% of Kolkata's office inventory is eligible for modernisation. The firm estimates this could unlock Rs 4,800 crore in value, with valuations rising 48% to Rs 15,000 crore. The report identifies retrofitting as a way to capture value from existing structures.

stories.title: Knight Frank estimates Rs 3.76 trillion office retrofitting potential
stories.summary: Knight Frank India estimates that 301 million square feet of office space across eight cities could be retrofitted to unlock Rs 3.76 trillion in value. The firm projects a 76% uplift in asset valuations. The report highlights the opportunity to extract more value from existing real estate.

stories.title: Mumbai office retrofitting could double asset value
stories.summary: Modernising 68 million square feet of office space in Mumbai could unlock Rs 1.78 lakh crore in value, according to Knight Frank India. The firm estimates valuations could rise 96% to Rs 3.63 lakh crore. Retrofitting is presented as a solution to the difficulty of replicating premium commercial locations.

stories.title: NCR office retrofits could unlock Rs 1.07 trillion
stories.summary: Knight Frank India estimates that 209 million square feet of office space in the National Capital Region is suitable for retrofitting. The firm projects an 82% increase in asset valuations, adding Rs 1.07 trillion in value. The consultancy views these existing assets as significant untapped opportunities.

stories.title: Poland warehouse market sees rising demand
stories.summary: Panattoni has leased nearly 1.15 million square metres of warehouse space in Poland since the start of 2026. The developer's vacancy rate has fallen to 2.68%. Meanwhile, SCM has signed a 10-year lease for 1,200 square metres of office space at Warsaw's Crown Square.

stories.title: India data centre spending forecast to grow 28.4% in 2027
stories.summary: Gartner forecasts that India's data centre spending will reach INR 1.206 trillion in 2027, a 28.4% increase. The firm attributes the growth to hyperscalers and cloud providers expanding capacity for AI demand. The country is currently advancing its ambition to become a global hub for AI infrastructure.

stories.title: Nvidia crisis impacts India data centre operations
stories.summary: India's data centre firms are reportedly concerned about a potential shift in Nvidia's financing model. The sector is currently navigating these uncertainties alongside broader tech growth. Data centre plans are being routed through the current compute landscape, which is currently described as rattled.

stories.title: 150MW data centre project planned for Haifa
stories.summary: Enlight Renewable Energy and Shemen Yielding Real Estate have agreed to develop a 150MW data centre in Haifa, Israel. The project will be built on 20 acres of land in a 50:50 joint venture. A grid connection application has been submitted for the site.

stories.title: Prologis expands European warehouse network
stories.summary: Prologis has established a European logistics joint venture to broaden its warehouse network. The company reported that rents across its network continued to climb during the latest quarter. The firm is currently navigating shifting interest rate expectations while attempting to deepen its presence in key logistics corridors.

Westcore acquires Seattle-area industrial campus for $51.1 million
stories.summary: A Westcore-affiliated entity has acquired the Woodinville Corporate Center I for $51.1 million. The multi-tenant industrial park was sold by Blackstone’s Link Logistics. The property is located along the SR-522 Corridor in the Woodinville submarket.

stories.title: Amrize expands Memphis cement terminal
stories.summary: Amrize is expanding its Memphis Cement Terminal to support infrastructure and construction growth in the Tri-State Area. The project aims to reinforce the company's logistics network and supply local builders with cement from its Missouri plant. The expansion was marked by an open house for local officials.

stories.title: Northern Europe Energy plans data centre in Finland
stories.summary: Northern Europe Energy Group is planning an 80,000 square metre data centre in Riihimäki, Finland. The project is situated on a 16-hectare site and is not expected to be completed until the 2030s at the earliest. The company has signed an agreement with the local municipality.

stories.title: Signature Global enters Mumbai market with 475-acre land buy in Raigad
stories.summary: Signature Global has acquired 474.66 acres of land in Raigad for 194.19 crore rupees via an online auction. The purchase marks the developer's first entry into the Mumbai Metropolitan Region, expanding its operations beyond its core Delhi-NCR market. The company plans to retain a majority stake.

stories.title: Bengaluru metro corridor completion pushed to 2033
stories.summary: The proposed 37.8-km Hebbal-Sarjapur Metro corridor in Bengaluru has seen its expected completion date pushed from 2031 to April 2033. The project is still awaiting approval from the Union government, nearly two years after the state government cleared the plan. The route remains on paper.

stories.title: Haryana Rera orders Vatika to pay compensation for deed delays
stories.summary: Haryana Rera has ordered Vatika Ltd to refund escalation and maintenance charges to two buyers and pay 2.5 lakh rupees in compensation. The developer failed to execute a conveyance deed for a commercial unit despite receiving full payment in 2016 and an occupation certificate in 2021.

stories.title: Emaar directed to pay compensation for Rera rule violations
stories.summary: Haryana Rera has ordered Emaar India to pay 3 lakh rupees in compensation to a homebuyer for violating the Real Estate Act. The developer collected over 10 percent of the sale price before executing a builder-buyer agreement. The buyer had sought 50 lakh rupees in damages.

stories.title: Rera orders builder to refund 27 lakh rupees for villa project delay
stories.summary: Telangana Rera has directed SVM Aditya Homes to refund 27.1 lakh rupees to a buyer after the firm failed to deliver a villa in an unregistered project. The authority also awarded 10.8 percent annual interest. The developer has 60 days to complete the payment.

stories.title: Rera rules registration cannot be bypassed by later filing
stories.summary: Telangana Rera has fined Atluri Developers 15 lakh rupees for selling units in a commercial project before obtaining mandatory registration. The authority ruled that registering a project after the fact does not erase the initial violation of the Real Estate Act. Compliance is expected within 30 days.

stories.title: Layout approval does not replace Rera registration
stories.summary: Telangana Rera has fined a promoter 5.3 lakh rupees for selling plots in an unregistered project. The authority rejected the promoter's plea of ignorance, ruling that layout permission is not a substitute for mandatory Rera registration. Ignorance of the law remains an expensive defense.

stories.summary: Context: Marking 10 years since the enactment of the Real Estate (Regulation and Development) Act (RERA), 2016, the Cabinet Secretariat initiated high-level consultations with the homebuyers’ body Forum for People’s Collective Efforts (FPCE). stories.title: Gurugram seals 37 properties for unauthorised commercial use
stories.summary: The Department of Town and Country Planning has sealed 37 properties in Gurugram's DLF Phase 2, including clinics and supermarkets. The three-day crackdown targeted residential buildings operating as commercial establishments in violation of land-use norms. The department has finished its sweep of the area.

stories.title: Consumer group finds most states hide agent discipline records
stories.summary: A report from the Consumer Policy Center found that most state license portals provide incomplete or misleading information regarding disciplinary actions against real estate agents. Only Illinois and Arizona received a good rating for transparency. Most states appear to prefer that these records remain difficult to find.

stories.title: Most states bury agent discipline records, consumer group finds
stories.summary: Only two states earned a "good" rating in a Consumer Policy Center review of the state real estate commission licensing portals used by buyers and sellers. Key points: - A new report from the CPC concluded that nearly all state real estate commissions need to improve the online tools they

stories.title: Dubai Residential REIT reports revenue growth
stories.summary: Dubai Residential REIT reported 7.6 percent revenue growth over the last nine months. The company also announced that its total assets have risen to AED 25.2 billion during the same period.

stories.title: H&R REIT analysts maintain hold consensus
stories.summary: H&R Real Estate Investment Trust has a consensus price target of C$11.36 from analysts. Four of seven analysts rate the stock a hold, while three recommend buying. The units traded at C$9.70 on Tuesday, remaining below the average target set by the firm.

stories.title: Scotia raises H&R REIT price target
stories.summary: Scotia raised its price target on H&R REIT from C$10.50 to C$11.75, maintaining a sector perform rating. The company reported a quarterly loss of C$1.88 per share on revenue of C$171.8 million. Shares fell 1.6 percent to C$9.69 on Tuesday.

stories.title: BMO downgrades H&R REIT
stories.summary: BMO Capital Markets downgraded H&R REIT from outperform to market perform, cutting its price target to C$10.50. The REIT recently reported a quarterly loss of C$1.88 per share on revenue of C$171.8 million. Shares fell 1.6 percent to C$9.69 on Tuesday.

stories.title: True North Commercial REIT reports portfolio size
stories.summary: True North Commercial Real Estate Investment Trust operates a portfolio of 37 properties totaling 4.4 million square feet. The REIT, which reported an EPS of -1.16, is scheduled to release its next earnings report on November 10, 2026.

stories.title: UOA REIT net property income rises
stories.summary: UOA Real Estate Investment Trust reported a 22.4 percent increase in net property income to RM21.58 million for the third quarter. The company attributed the growth to improved occupancy and lower maintenance costs. Net profit rose 41 percent despite higher borrowing costs.

stories.title: UOA Real Estate Investment Trust reports Q3 revenue
stories.summary: UOA Real Estate Investment Trust reported revenue of 31.98 million RGT for the third quarter of 2026.

ZAMINAI and San Diego MLS partner on AI intelligence
stories.summary: ZAMINAI and San Diego MLS have signed a memorandum of understanding to develop AI-powered property intelligence. The collaboration will operate through the Global Data Exchange network, aiming to make property decisions more transparent, evidence-based and personalized for users.

stories.title: PropertyAdvice.ai launches video tool
stories.summary: PropertyAdvice.ai has launched an AI-powered video maker that converts listing photos into cinematic videos. The company claims the tool requires no subscriptions, credits or complicated software, allowing real estate professionals to add customizable property information and disclosure labels to their listings.

stories.title: CubiCasa expands AI photo editing features
stories.summary: CubiCasa has announced new AI-powered capabilities for its photo editing product, two months after the initial launch. The company says the enhancements provide improved image quality and a faster workflow, designed to help real estate photographers produce listing-ready images with less manual effort.

stories.title: Contour launches private markets platform
stories.summary: Contour has launched an intelligence platform for wealth advisors to evaluate and monitor investment funds. The tool combines regulatory filings with analytical visualizations for private credit, real estate and infrastructure. Wealth management firms currently advise on more than $1 trillion in private market assets.

stories.title: Residential real estate seeks better data
stories.summary: Residential real estate is increasingly dependent on digital information, yet property details remain scattered across various databases. Industry organizations are responding with new data standards and appraisal reporting requirements to ensure information can be accurately recorded and interpreted across systems involved in a transaction.

stories.title: Zillow adds consumer comparison tools
stories.summary: Zillow has launched four new tools intended to help prospective buyers and sellers navigate moving decisions. The portal says the updates provide localized and personalized information regarding affordability, location and transaction assistance to make the process easier for consumers.

stories.title: Ocree launches tokenized real estate pilot
stories.summary: Ocree Corporation has partnered with the Canadian Securities Exchange and Apex Group to pilot the distribution of tokenized private real estate securities. The project, called Bedrock, aims to test if existing exchange and custody systems can support tokenized investments without requiring new platforms.

Commercial real estate broker notes AI inaccuracies
stories.summary: A commercial real estate broker reported that a client provided a list of five properties generated by ChatGPT. Upon investigation, the broker found that some listings were expired, some were off-market and one building did not exist. The AI had simply made it up.

stories.title: Rising material costs stall home construction in Kashmir
stories.summary: Building a home in Kashmir is increasingly difficult as the price of cement, steel, bricks, and timber rises. Families report stalled construction and unfinished walls as original budgets fail to cover the cost of materials. The aspiration for a secure roof is currently slipping out of reach.

stories.title: Carlisle Companies to acquire PermaTherm
stories.summary: Carlisle Companies has agreed to acquire Georgia-based PermaTherm, a manufacturer of insulated metal panels. The deal aims to expand Carlisle’s presence in a North American market the company estimates is worth more than $2 billion. Financial terms of the transaction were not disclosed.

Ibstock sells quarry business for £50 million
stories.summary: Building materials manufacturer Ibstock has sold its quarry business in the Midlands for £50.1 million. The company stated the sale realizes value from reserves developed through a multi-year investment in the site. The buyer was not named in the announcement.

stories.title: Granite acquires Utah and Tennessee businesses
stories.summary: Granite has acquired Construction Materials Company in Utah and Ford Construction’s businesses in Tennessee. The deals, which closed November 13, are expected to generate more than $175 million in combined 2027 revenue. The acquisitions add aggregate facilities and ready-mix concrete plants to the company’s portfolio.

stories.title: Nvidia earnings highlight AI infrastructure stocks
stories.summary: Nvidia’s upcoming Q3 report has placed data center landlords and power suppliers in focus. Investors are looking for ripple effects from AI spending in real estate and utilities. Simply Wall St identified nine additional companies with data center and power stories beyond the three stocks currently under review.

stories.title: Ibstock completes £50 million quarry sale
stories.summary: Ibstock has sold 100% of the shares in Redhurst CC, which owns a Staffordshire quarry, to an unnamed global building materials group for £50.1 million. The sale follows a multi-year effort to develop the site’s calcined clay reserves for use as a lower-carbon cement alternative.

stories.title: Ibstock sells Redhurst quarry to global group
stories.summary: Ibstock has sold its Redhurst quarry and associated assets to a global building materials group for £50.1 million. The parties have also signed a long-term supply agreement for ceramic clay. The deal marks the end of a multi-year research and commercialization program for the site.

stories.title: Study suggests retrofitting Kolkata offices could unlock value
stories.summary: Knight Frank India estimates that retrofitting Kolkata’s ageing office stock could unlock nearly Rs 4,800 crore in incremental value. Upgrading these assets to meet current sustainability and operational requirements could increase the total valuation of the city’s eligible office space by approximately 48 percent.

Jordan launches $40 million roadmap to decarbonize buildings
stories.summary: Jordan has launched a national roadmap to decarbonize its construction sector by 2050. The plan includes 12 projects and 72 measures with an indicative budget of $40 million. The initiative aims to support the country's National Energy Strategy and improve energy efficiency across economic sectors.

stories.title: OJK encourages banks to finance green building projects
stories.summary: The Financial Services Authority of Indonesia is urging banks to increase sustainability-linked loan financing for green building transformations. Officials stated that collaboration between the financial sector and businesses is essential to drive productive investment and strengthen the country’s position in low-carbon development.

stories.title: Kenya joins global cement decarbonization initiative
stories.summary: Kenya has joined an initiative to mobilize technical and financial support for industrial decarbonization, starting with cement production. The country is one of four pilot participants in the Global Decarbonization Investment Accelerator, which was launched at the COP31 climate conference in Türkiye.

stories.title: Heidelberg Materials expands decarbonization training online
stories.summary: Heidelberg Materials UK has launched an online platform to provide digital training on sustainable construction. The program extends the company’s existing in-person seminars. The first sessions will focus on carbon-captured cement and lower-carbon concrete, with live streams scheduled for November 24.

stories.title: Heidelberg Materials launches online decarbonization program
stories.summary: Heidelberg Materials UK has introduced live-streamed training sessions on sustainable construction. The program builds on the company’s physical training venues and offers guidance on using lower-carbon materials across the supply chain. The first online sessions are scheduled to begin on November 24.

stories.title: Absa Bank Kenya headquarters recognized for energy savings
stories.summary: The Absa Bank Kenya head office has been named a national champion in the World Championship for Energy Savings. The facility recorded a 48.6 percent reduction in carbon emissions and saved over 405,000 kilowatt-hours of energy annually following targeted infrastructure upgrades.

stories.title: Homebuilder confidence sinks to a 14-year low
stories.summary: Homebuilder confidence fell to 25 in November, the lowest reading since April 2012. The National Association of Home Builders reports that 46 percent of builders cut prices to move inventory, the highest share since the pandemic began. Discounts are currently holding at 6 percent.

stories.title: Home builder sentiment reaches 14-year low
stories.summary: The National Association of Home Builders and Wells Fargo index fell four points to 25 in November. The decline is attributed to high interest rates, inflation, and tariffs on energy and materials. The index is now at its lowest point since April 2012.

stories.title: Bleak house: Builder confidence hits 14-year low in November - Chicago Agent Magazine
US homebuilder sentiment hits 14-year low
stories.summary: The National Association of Home Builders index dropped to 25 in November, missing economist forecasts of 29. Chairman Bill Owe stated that immigration enforcement is keeping workers off job sites and driving up costs. The industry remains below the 50 point threshold for a positive outlook.

stories.title: Homebuilder confidence hits new 14-year low
stories.summary: Builder confidence in new single-family home sales fell to 25, marking the lowest reading since April 2012. Sentiment has remained below 40 for 19 consecutive months. Any reading below 50 indicates a negative view of the market. The industry describes the current climate as strange.

stories.title: Builder Sentiment Falls to 14-Year Low in November - Builder Magazine
US homebuilder confidence falls as nearly half cut prices
stories.summary: Confidence among U.S. single-family homebuilders sank to 25 in November, its weakest level in more than 14 years. Nearly half of all builders are now trimming prices to attract buyers. A year ago, the index stood at 38, and all three primary components have since declined.

stories.title: US Homebuilder Sentiment Sags to Fresh 14-Year Low on High Rates - Bloomberg.com
Homebuilder sentiment plunges to 14-year low
stories.summary: Builder confidence fell to 25 in November, the lowest level since April 2012. Higher mortgage rates, labor costs, and material prices have led more builders to drop prices. The average rate on a 30-year fixed mortgage reached 7.51 percent on Monday.
